exact_items: artifacts preserve canonical run/thread/attempt linkage
receipt-like exports should not invent shadow IDs
usage-linked artifacts route through canonical usage identity
advisory concern with no execution effect -> info or warning
concern tied to weak integration but not yet completion-blocking -> warning or attention_required
concern that blocks seam completion, promotion, or recovery -> blocked
acknowledged concerns should reduce repeat in-app surfacing, but must not mask an active blocked state if the underlying condition still blocks progress
blocked owner User: eligible for thread/chat prompt, Dashboard/Progress CtA, and possibly system notification
blocked owner Package/Seam Overseer / Corroboration: operational surfaces first, user escalation only if persistence or decision need crosses threshold
blocked owner Runtime / Recovery / Graph Patch: Progress/History/Node Graph first; user notification only when action or trust decision actually needed
blocked owner External Resource: warning/banner first, system notification only if it stalls meaningful progress long enough
notes: Blocked owner influences both destination surface and notification style

exact_items: stale projection: local in-app indicators may show but wording must disclose possible staleness
degraded projection: avoid strong notification claims relying on incomplete projections; prefer canonical event/blocked record-rooted notifications
notes: degraded concern rollup should not emit 'N new concerns' system notification unless canonical records support it

exact_items: a canonical blocked event can still drive notification even if some projection surfaces are degraded
severity increase
blocked owner change
concern changes from advisory to execution-impacting
blocked duration threshold crossed
trust state improves enough that previously suppressed actions become available
trust state degrades enough that prior assumptions are no longer safe
notes: Trust state changes in both directions are valid resurfacing triggers

exact_items: pressure/threshold warnings may use quiet periods
blocked states and canonical action-needed episodes may NOT quietly disappear behind the same suppression rule
notes: Especially important when usage/account pressure turns into actual blocked execution condition
